name: Is Winter Real?
source:
"Is Winter Real?" is a short horror game made in five days for Winter Visual Novel Jam 2022. 

You find a weird machine with a mysterious AI, apparently designed to generate images based on the prompt you enter. 

Images can do no harm, right?

[From [url=https://aniszorek.itch.io/is-winter-real]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“冬天真的存在吗？”是一款为2022年冬季视觉小说Jam制作的短篇恐怖游戏，历时五天。

你会发现一台奇怪的机器，它有一个神秘的人工智能，显然是为了根据你输入的提示生成图像而设计的。

图像不会造成任何伤害，对吧？

[来自[url=https://aniszorek.itch.io/is-winter-real]Itch.io[/url]]
